# El Negma Pallets - مصنع النجمة للبالتات الخشبية

## About
El Negma Pallets (مصنع النجمة للبالتات الخشبية) is Egypt's leading wooden pallet manufacturer, specializing in new heat-treated wooden pallets that comply with ISPM-15 international phytosanitary standards. We serve Egyptian exporters, factories, logistics companies, and agricultural export stations across Egypt and the Arab world.

> Company: شركة النجمة للبالتات الخشبية (El Negma Pallets for Wooden Pallet Manufacturing)
> Founded: 2006 | 18+ years of manufacturing experience
> Location: Industrial Zone, Biyad Al Arab, Beni Suef, Egypt — Postal Code 62721 (Coordinates: 29.0661, 31.0980)
> Phone / WhatsApp: +20 108 001 2261
> Certifications: ISPM-15 Heat Treatment (HT), ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018
> Languages: Arabic (primary), English

## Products
- Euro Pallet (EUR 1): 120 × 80 cm, 1,500 kg dynamic load, EPAL certified
- Industrial Pallet (GMA/Middle East): 120 × 100 cm, 1,500 kg dynamic load
- American GMA Pallet: 121 × 101 cm (48" × 40"), standard North America
- Chemical Square Pallet: 114 × 114 cm, 4-way entry, chemical industry
- Heavy Duty Square Pallet: 100 × 100 cm, 2,000 kg load
- Custom-built pallets to buyer specifications (dimensions, wood type, load rating)
- Export wooden crates and pallet collars for international shipping
- ISPM-15 heat-treated (HT) and methyl bromide (MB) fumigated pallets with full export documentation

## Services
- Manufacturing new wooden pallets to custom specifications
- Heat treatment (HT) and ISPM-15 phytosanitary certification for international export
- Supplying pallets for citrus/agricultural export season (citrus, grapes, potato, vegetables, dates)
- Pallet recycling, repair, and reuse programs for logistics cost reduction
- Bulk contracts for factories, warehouses, and shipping companies (minimum order quantities apply)
